Overview

eMaint CMMS by Fluke Reliability bridges computerized maintenance management with industrial vibration, thermal, and electrical condition monitoring. Designed for plants that rely on Fluke diagnostic sensors, eMaint offers deep table customization, regulatory audit logs, and predictive maintenance capabilities.

Best For: Reliability engineers and plants utilizing Fluke condition-monitoring hardware

Core Capabilities

Fluke Connect Hardware Integration

Seamlessly ingest telemetry data from Fluke 3563 vibration sensors and thermal sensors directly into condition-monitoring dashboards.

Configurable Architecture & Custom Tables

Customize forms, custom fields, approval workflows, and relational tables to match unique plant processes.

MRO Multi-Site Inventory Management

Manage distributed storerooms, min/max reorder levels, purchase requisition routing, and vendor catalogs.

Audit Logging & FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Compliance

Built-in electronic signatures, unalterable historical audit trails, and calibration history documentation.

Pros

  • Direct integration with Fluke vibration, thermal, and electrical sensors
  • High degree of custom field configuration and table customization
  • Robust audit logging conforming to FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and ISO guidelines

Cons

  • Interface feels more traditional and less modern than newer mobile tools
  • Setup requires structured planning and administration overhead
